## The lab By Metro

The lab is 10 min walk from the [*Begoña*]{.underline} Metro Station (Exit to *San Modesto* 😇). Follow the dashed line to the Biochemistry Department door. The arrow indicates a shortcut using a small door to the Medicine Campus.

Once inside the Campus walk straight until you find the big building of the School of Medicine.

![](images/mapa_metro_lab.jpg)
